Looking for a portable cabin in Noida? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer supplying steel-frame, insulated portable cabins for site offices, security posts, staff rooms and home-office use across Sector 62, Sector 137 and Noida Extension. We build to order and dispatch from our own Greater Noida factory, so you deal with the maker, not a reseller — and get a clear quote, honest lead times and a written warranty.

What does a portable cabin in Noida cost?

There is no single fixed price — a portable cabin is quoted on what you actually need. Cost is driven mainly by floor size, panel type and thickness, insulation level, number of doors and windows, any toilet or partition, electrical fittings, the finish you choose, and delivery distance to your Noida site. Tell us the size and use, and we send a clear written quote.

The main factors that move the price are:

  • Size — a 10×10 ft guard cabin costs far less than a 40×10 ft multi-room site office.
  • Panel and insulation — standard single-skin sheet versus ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels.
  • Fit-out — toilet, internal partition, windows, wiring, lights, AC points.
  • Finish — basic powder-coated steel versus upgraded interior and exterior finish.
  • Delivery — distance from our Greater Noida factory to your site (₹3,000 default delivery applies).

Because pricing depends on these choices, we do not list a flat rate. Share your requirement and get a quote you can actually compare.

Portable Cabin Sizes and Configurations

Noida buyers use portable cabins for many jobs, so we build a range of sizes and layouts. Common configurations include:

  • Site offices — from compact 10×10 ft units up to 40×10 ft multi-room cabins for project managers and site staff, with electrical fittings and an optional toilet.
  • Portable cabin offices — insulated cabin offices for IT, real-estate and contractor teams in commercial sectors like Sector 62 and Sector 63, with partitions and finished interiors.
  • Security cabins — small, well-glazed guard posts for site gates, corporate entrances and residential complexes.
  • Cabins with toilet or pantry — single units with a built-in washroom or pantry for longer postings.
  • Home-office and extra-room cabins — insulated units for a study, guest room or garden office at a Noida home.

Every layout can be customised — wall and floor finishes, window and door positions, partitions, and electrical or plumbing points to suit your site.

How SAMAN Portable Cabins Are Built

A SAMAN portable cabin is a steel-frame structure, not a converted shipping box. The frame is made from MS steel to IS 2062, so it stays straight and stable on uneven site ground and survives repeated relocation. Wall and roof panels are ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum core density) with a pre-galvanised steel skin, which keeps the cabin cooler through a Noida summer and quieter inside. Steelwork is powder-coated, and roofing is GI sheet. The result is a unit you can dismantle, move and reuse without structural damage.

Delivery and Installation Across Noida

Your cabin is built and finished at our Greater Noida factory and then trucked to your site, which keeps transit short for Noida deliveries. Standard transit is around 3–5 days once a unit is ready; custom or fully fitted cabins take longer to build before dispatch. Delivery is ₹3,000 by default, and our team handles positioning and basic levelling on arrival.

One useful local point: during Delhi-NCR GRAP construction-ban windows (typically October to February), wet on-site construction is often restricted, but factory-built, dry-assembled cabins are generally not barred — a real advantage when you still need workspace during a ban. We deliver across Noida, Greater Noida and the wider NCR; tell us your sector and we confirm timing.

Why Buy Factory-Direct from SAMAN

SAMAN Portable is the brand of SAMAN POS India Private Limited. Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we run an ISO 9001:2015 quality system and have delivered 500+ projects across India. Buying direct from the manufacturer means no middleman markup, a single point of accountability, and a written warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.) We are an enquiry-based business — there is no online checkout. You get a quote, confirm the spec, and we build. A 7-day customer-paid return window applies after delivery.

Frequently Asked Questions About Portable Cabins in Noida


How long does delivery of a portable cabin to Noida take?

For a standard unit, transit to a Noida site is usually around 3–5 days once the cabin is ready. Custom or fully fitted cabins take longer because the build itself takes more time before dispatch from our Greater Noida factory. We confirm a realistic date with your quote.


What decides the price of a portable cabin in Noida?

Price depends on floor size, panel type and insulation thickness, the number of doors and windows, any toilet or partition, electrical fittings, the finish, and delivery distance. A small guard cabin is far cheaper than a large multi-room site office. Share your requirement for an itemised quote.


Do I need permission to install a portable cabin in Noida?

For temporary use on a construction site or private property, requirements are usually minimal. Permanent installations, especially in residential sectors like Sector 137, may need local approval depending on use. Check with your local authority; our team can explain what is typically asked for.


Can a portable cabin be relocated later?

Yes. Because the cabin is a bolted steel-frame structure with panel walls, it can be dismantled, transported and reinstalled at a new site without structural damage — a key reason buyers choose a cabin over fixed construction.


Are portable cabins suitable for Noida's climate?

Yes. The ~50 mm insulated PUF panels reduce heat gain in summer and hold warmth in winter, and the steel skin with GI roofing handles monsoon rain. Cabins can be fitted with AC points and proper ventilation for year-round comfort.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN portable cabin?

Every unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing, and the structure has a 20–25 year engineered service life. The service life is an engineering estimate of how long the structure lasts with care, not a warranty period.

Get a Portable Cabin Quote for Noida

Tell us your size, use and delivery sector, and we will send a clear written quote with lead time. Talk to SAMAN directly — the manufacturer, not a reseller.

Call +91 62009 09435 · WhatsApp +91 97089 89937 · or use Send Enquiry. We supply across Noida, including Sector 62, Sector 137 and Noida Extension. Browse our full portable cabin range, or see the office portable cabin and portable cabin with toilet options.
